entities.name: James, Brother of Jesus
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Brother of Jesus and leader of the Jerusalem church (c. 30–62 CE). Presided over the Council of Jerusalem (Acts 15) that decided Gentile inclusion. His epistle emphasizes practical faith through works. Martyred by the Sanhedrin in 62 CE.
